trap.label: present perfect com since
trap.why: Em português dizemos “moro aqui desde 2019” (presente). Em inglês, ação que começou no passado e continua usa Present Perfect com since/for, não o presente simples ou contínuo.

mcq.q: They have lived here ___ ten years.
Which is correct? (present perfect com since)

fix.wrong: I have know Ana for years.
fix.right: I have known Ana for years.

fix.wrong: She wants that I help her.
fix.right: She wants me to help her.

fix.wrong: We have lived here since five years.
fix.right: We have lived here for five years.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com for: “I have studied English since 2020.” (hoje = 2025)
rewrite.answer: I have studied English for five years.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com want: “I want to leave. You must stay.” → Eu quero que você fique.

rewrite.why: hasn't ou has not é aceito; use hasn't.
